test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'CHECK' is written as '6165622' and 'SURGE' is written as '382136145'.How will 'PRIEST' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• **Vowels → Position value according to English alphabetic series is written.**
 
• **Consonants → Position value according to English alphabetic series is multiplied by (2).**

So,

 
• 'CHECK' is written as '6165622'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ce971e94c9f41fe1af04528af01496e9e17dbe34dfeddfba68ac6f8ca0f0dba.png] 

And,

 
• 'SURGE' is written as '382136145'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb5ddf0a4a7ea52c881cf38ad035607fb8471d908ccc6c69954b1e0e6e0a77df.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'PRIEST' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebea90d3cfdc33467a4bafe05924d00f6713e7561f2bdd2c139755ff3dce3e49.png] 

​Hence, "**3236953840**" is the correct answer.

8d
